title: rdp_ear: decode inner content of packets
description:
This patch adds support for decoding the inner content of RDPEAR packets. We have
added a dissector generated with pidl from the LSASS remoting IDL given in MS-RDPEAR.
The IDL from the spec has been adjusted to work with pidl. Also the code has been generated
with a modified version of pidl, as it seems that otherwise conformant runs don't work as
expected (so rcg.idl not integrated to generated file for now)

Are the pidl changes compatible with the rest of the pidl generated dissectors? If so the changes should be pushed upstream to samba. I'd like to have all parts needed to generate the dissector in the repo.

All the changes are in `lib/Parse/Pidl/Wireshark/NDR.pm`, so pretty much wireshark specific.

My changes are about:
* adding handling of alignment in unions (flag parsed by core `pidl` but not used in the wireshark module)
* fix pointer on array of structures. It's missing `if (di->conformant_run) return offset;` at the beginning of struct parsing

I'm gonna check that all of these changes are still needed for RCG (as `pidl` has been updated recently).
If all the changes are in `lib/Parse/Pidl/Wireshark/NDR.pm` then upstream Samba is quite likely to accept them. I synced both of them a little while ago but we have some new changes to push upstream.

I don't understand why the pipeline breaks, can someone enlighten me ?

If I check out your branch, and make in <build>/epan/dissectors/asn1/p1

I get the same error as the pipeline, i.e.,

../../../../../wireshark/epan/dissectors/asn1/p1/p1.cnf:175: UserWarning: Could not set type of class member EXTENSION.&&absent to _VariableTypeValueSetFieldSpec
  &absent			_VariableTypeValueSetFieldSpec
Built target generate_dissector-p1
I just somehow corrupted my git repo, so wasn't able to check whether branch was checked out correctly, whether the same command would succeed under clean master.

If you look at the raw output it becomes clearer https://cdn.artifacts.gitlab-static.net/61/11/6111def0dc735931432c41417a8b96d3feb8c4ceca2b71dd9d4ef030d6c74ebb/2024_08_12/7563308276/8280466771/job.log?response-content-type=text%2Fplain%3B%20charset%3Dutf-8&response-content-disposition=inline&Expires=1723476145&KeyName=gprd-artifacts-cdn&Signature=L59OmcBAprC6XLMwYjdd2AUpYRA=

The problem is that the Clang builder regenmerates all pidl dissector and detects a discrepancy(I think). You need to regenerate all the pidl dissectors as part of your commit.

Example:

diff --git a/epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-atsvc.c b/epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-atsvc.c index 3efaa9a9..0f9eae0a 100644 --- a/epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-atsvc.c +++ b/epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-atsvc.c @@ -565,6 +565,8 @@ atsvc_dissect_struct_JobInfo(tvbuff_t \*tvb \_U\_, int offset \_U\_, packet_info \*pin proto_tree \*tree = NULL; int old_offset; + if (di-\>conformant_run) return offset; +
P.S I can't judge if the difference is benign or not...

commits_data.message:
Various changes in pidl generator

This patch does various fixes to have code generated correctly for rcg.idl:

* correctly handle full pointers (basically ref pointers that can be NULL)
* treat alignment directive in unions
